senses.gloss: (denom. of אֶצְבַּע) to raise one or more fingers for the casting of lots.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 2:1">Yoma II, 1</cite> <he>הממונה … הַצְבִּיעוּ</he> the superintending priest said to them, raise your fingers; <cite ref="Tamid 28a">Tam. 28ᵃ</cite>; Y. Yoma II, 39ᵈ top, expl. <he>הוציאו אצבע</he>.
